articles.title: King Harald V’s final farewell: Inside the historic funeral set to bring Norway to a standstill - HOLA
articles.description: Norway prepares to bid farewell to King Harald V with a solemn funeral and procession in Oslo, as European royals gather to honor the late monarch.
articles.content: The funeral of King Harald V of Norway will bring together in Oslo Cathedral many of the worlds most prominent leaders. It will involve an extraordinary security operation, the largest in Norways his… [+6425 chars]
